example-echo._comment: A real (if trivial) stdio MCP server, enabled by default so a fresh checkout has one working local upstream out of the box. Add your own servers here (same shape as the main agentic-workspace .mcp.json), or let apps dial in via /link instead of listing them here at all.

example-leaf-gateway._comment: type='gateway' federates ANOTHER aw-mcp-gateway's whole tool pool into this one, one namespace level deeper ({this-name}__{remote-upstream}__{tool}). Template only — add it to gateway.json's 'upstreams' list once you have a real remote to point at.
